Raises significant concerns about aviation safety.
Highlights need for better fatigue management strategies.

Health.headline: Experts call on UN to declare climate change a health emergency
Health.summary: Health experts are urging the UN to declare climate change a global health emergency, emphasizing its profound and escalating impacts on human well-being. This call seeks to mobilize greater international action and resources to address the crisis.
key_points: Health experts urge UN to declare climate change health emergency.
Emphasizes profound impacts on human well-being.
Calls for greater international action and resources.
